# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `crossmint` MCP server pointing at Crossmint's hosted Menta Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://menta.crossmint.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Menta sign-in, with no API key or client ID to configure.
- Listed for Grok Bot only.
- Logo: Crossmint's official mark, `crossmint-mark-gradient.svg` from crossmint.com/brand, centered on a square canvas.
